properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on main 7f5984ec5 and the v0.79.0 assets): reflow2 names two install shapes, the installer's `reflow2` wrapper and the binary alone, and documents installing only one. The release tarball holds only reflow2-mcp, the release notes say 'See CHANGELOG.md', and nothing says how to tell which shape a machine has. So a hand install improvises, and a wrong guess replaces the wrapper
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-05, on art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05, entry [defect] (lines 358-367). The question: what in reflow2 let a hand-written install recipe clobber the wrapper. The recipe itself was the maintainer's agent's (fact:the-0-79-0-install-near-miss-came-from-a-recipe-written-in-chat-not-from-reflow2-2026-10-05).

① OBSERVED: the recipe's `ln -sf ~/.local/bin/reflow2-mcp ~/.local/bin/reflow2   # makes reflow2 read / reflow2 write work` would have replaced a wrapper "installed by reflow2_install.py". EXPECTED, the reporter's words: the recipe "checks for the wrapper first, e.g. `[ -e ~/.local/bin/reflow2 ] || ln -s …`, or says 'skip if `reflow2 --version` already works'".

② PRECEDENT: none for a hand install. cap:machine-wide-install says the installer puts "a `reflow2` command on PATH".

③ CANDIDATES:
(A) no documented install with only the binary exists.
(B) the documents name both shapes, and give no way to tell them apart.
(C) the release ships nothing to install by hand from.
(D) not reflow2's: the agent ignored a documented procedure.

④⑤ MEASURED:
- (A) HOLDS. getting-started/UPDATING.md's local update is install.sh only. getting-started/SETUP.md and docs/using-reflow2-in-vscode-without-mcp.md both say that "with only the binary" the verbs are `reflow2-mcp read …`. crates/reflow2-mcp/src/verbs.rs keeps the verbs in the binary because "a verb kept in this script would be missing wherever only the binary is installed". So reflow2 expects machines with only the binary, and never says how one is installed or upgraded.
- (B) HOLDS. The wrapper's only mark is its comment line, "# reflow2 — installed by reflow2_install.py", and no document names it as the check.
- (C) HOLDS. reflow2-mcp-linux-x86_64.tar.gz (v0.79.0) holds one file, reflow2-mcp. The release body is "See CHANGELOG.md for what changed." plus the container section.
- (D) REFUTED. There was no procedure for the agent to follow.

⑥ CLASS: the code supports an install shape on purpose, and no procedure documents it. So every hand install of that shape is improvised, and the improvisation cannot see the other shape. Would a fix here have stopped this case? Yes: a documented path for the binary alone whose first step is "if `~/.local/bin/reflow2` exists and says 'installed by reflow2_install.py', re-run the installer instead".

⑦⑧ NOT BUILT. The fix is to documents only (UPDATING.md and the release notes), it is additive, and it changes no MCP behaviour.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: why the work machine was upgraded by hand rather than by install.sh. The log does not say.
